container.title: HLTV
config.proxyServer: Proxy for reaching hltv.org and challenges.cloudflare.com, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7890`. Use the SAME network path as the browser you can open HLTV with, otherwise Cloudflare verification will loop. Falls back to the `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` environment variables when empty.
config.browserPath: Path to a Chromium-based browser executable used for fetching HLTV pages (Chrome / Edge / Chromium). Leave empty to auto-detect: Edge → Chrome → Chrome for Testing → Playwright-managed Chromium.
config.cfClearance: Escape hatch for a hard-flagged IP: paste the `cf_clearance` cookie value copied from a normal browser that can open hltv.org (F12 → Application → Cookies). Must be paired with `hltv.userAgent` from the same browser, and the browser must share this machine's public IP.
config.userAgent: The exact User-Agent of the browser the cf_clearance cookie was copied from (F12 → Console → navigator.userAgent). The cookie is only honored when the UA matches.
